build_googlebenchmark: build the Google Benchmark library using Conan and CMake with configurable LTO and exception options
configure_cmake_benchmark: configure CMake definitions for the Google Benchmark library including testing, LTO, and libc++ settings
package_googlebenchmark: package the built Google Benchmark library and copy the LICENSE file to the licenses directory
config_options_windows: configure Conan options for Windows builds by removing fPIC and validating Visual Studio version compatibility
collect_libs_platform: collect platform-specific linker libraries for Linux pthread, Windows shlwapi, or SunOS kstat
